extractions.description: The paper investigates the role of pre-training in lifelong learning, especially in reducing energy waste and mitigating catastrophic forgetting. It evaluates the performance of pre-trained models on various tasks and proposes methods to enhance lifelong learning without excessive model re-training.

climate_change_is_central.justification: The paper primarily discusses the role of pre-training in lifelong learning and catastrophic forgetting, with a mention of potential energy savings as a secondary benefit.
climate_change_is_central.quote: A key challenge to this paradigm is the phenomenon of catastrophic forgetting. With the increasing popularity and success of pre-trained models in machine learning, we pose the question: What role does pre-training play in lifelong learning, specifically with respect to catastrophic forgetting?
